tournament.name: ANZ Super Series Cycle 5 Regional Championship

decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game by using various spells and abilities to manage the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The key card in the deck, The One Ring, provides a powerful and versatile tool for exerting control over the game. By utilizing a mix of removal, counter spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck seeks to stall the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the control elements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck relies on cycling through your creatures to set up a massive board state before casting Living End to wipe the battlefield and bring all your creatures back into play. The deck includes a mix of creatures with cycling abilities and disruption spells to disrupt your opponent's game plan while setting up your combo. With the right sequencing and timing, you can overwhelm your opponent with a sudden onslaught of powerful creatures and secure a quick victory.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent to fill the graveyard quickly, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield for a powerful swarm of creatures. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck includes various creatures that can be cycled for additional effects, such as Architects of Will and Curator of Mysteries, providing additional utility. The lands in the deck provide the necessary colors of mana to support the combo strategy.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful removal spells, disruptive counterspells, and card draw engines. The key card, The One Ring, allows the player to manipulate their opponent's deck and potentially lock them out of the game entirely. By combining removal, counters, and card advantage, this deck seeks to outlast its opponent and win through attrition. Additionally, the inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional utility and synergy with the deck's strategy. Overall, this deck focuses on controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's plans to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Urza's Saga to quickly ramp up mana and generate value. By using lands like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber, the deck can repeatedly bounce and replay lands for additional mana. The inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove allow for even more mana acceleration. The deck aims to assemble powerful combos and quickly ramp into its win condition, utilizing lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Kessig Wolf Run to close out the game.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing creatures with cascade effects to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By casting spells with cascade, the player can put additional threats on the board without needing to spend additional resources. The deck also utilizes cards like Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own creatures. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent casting of spells and to enable the cascade mechanic effectively. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The deck aims to control the game through the use of Scapeshift and Leyline Binding to manipulate the board state and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Farseek and Explore, while utilizing powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sacred Foundry to deal damage. The inclusion of Wish allows for versatile responses to various situations, while cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove offer additional utility. Overall, the deck seeks to outmaneuver and outlast opponents in a strategic and calculated manner.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful spells and enchantments, utilizing The One Ring as a key card to dominate the battlefield. By combining cards like Leyline of the Guildpact, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Scion of Draco, players can manipulate the board state and outmaneuver their opponent. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude provides additional threats and removal options. The mana base is carefully constructed to support a variety of color requirements, ensuring a smooth and consistent gameplay experience.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of powerful planeswalkers and versatile removal spells. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to effectively manage the board state while using cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending to deal with opposing threats. The addition of Leyline Binding and Chalice of the Void helps to further control the opponent's plays. The deck aims to establish control early on and maintain it throughout the game, ultimately paving the way for a victorious finish.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and facilitate the quick ramping into Primeval Titan. The key strategy is to use land synergies and bounce lands to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to get Primeval Titan on the battlefield, as well as utilizing The One Ring for additional value. With the ability to search for key lands with cards like Expedition Map and Tolaria West, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful land-based threats.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with the Cascade mechanic to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cheat out high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation and Leyline of the Guildpact to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the different color requirements of the spells, ensuring a smooth and consistent gameplay experience. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, versatile, and disruptive in order to seize the advantage and win the game.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with abilities that synergize with each other, allowing the player to generate value and control the board through various interactions. The key strategy involves using creature tutoring spells like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to find the right creature for the situation, while also utilizing sacrifice outlets like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to fuel combo chains and trigger effects like Blood Artist. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient creature-based combos and synergies.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up your graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a surprise attack. The inclusion of cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Tainted Indulgence also adds to the combo potential, allowing for a versatile and unpredictable playstyle. Control elements like Solitude, Prismatic Ending, and Teferi, Time Raveler help ensure your strategy goes uninterrupted, making this deck a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cycle through your cards to fill up your graveyard with creatures, then use cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a massive board presence in a single turn, creating a powerful combo that can quickly close out the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation to disrupt your opponent's strategies and protect your own game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to protect itself with cards like Force of Negation and Counterspell, while using cards like Supreme Verdict and Solitude to deal with threats on the board. The centerpiece of the deck is The One Ring, which provides additional card advantage and control options. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and versatile cards like Fire / Ice to further solidify its control over the game.

This deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library by utilizing cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to trigger powerful mill effects like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity. The goal is to disrupt your opponent's game plan by milling important cards and ultimately win the game by depleting their library. The deck also includes control elements like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to deal with threats, while drawing into key cards with Visions of Beyond. Jace, the Perfected Mind provides a strong win condition once enough cards have been milled.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats. It utilizes a mix of land types to power up Tribal Flames and Scion of Draco, while also running efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to protect its creatures. The deck also benefits from the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional mana ramp. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to play fast, powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with a mix of aggression and control elements.

The deck utilizes the synergy between Primeval Titan, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp up mana and search for key lands like The One Ring and Urza's Saga. This allows for explosive turns and the ability to assemble powerful combos like fetching lands with Urza's Saga and generating extra mana with Simic Growth Chamber. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and land-based strategies while protecting key pieces with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly with cards like Azusa, Cultivator Colossus, and Arboreal Grazer to bring out powerful threats like Primeval Titan. The key strategy is to abuse the synergy between The One Ring, Amulet of Vigor, and Urza's Saga to generate huge amounts of mana and play multiple lands per turn. This allows the deck to quickly assemble the Amulet Titan combo, which can create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, having utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Radiant Fountain helps the deck survive longer against aggressive strategies.

This deck focuses on casting low-cost spells to trigger cascade effects, allowing you to put powerful creatures and spells into play for free. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent quickly with a flood of creatures and disruptive spells, while also controlling the board with removal. By combining aggression with card advantage through cascade, you can maintain pressure on your opponent and secure a swift victory. Additionally, the inclusion of bounce spells and counterspells adds versatility and protection to your game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cheap spells with cascade effects to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into big threats like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls. The inclusion of counterspells like Force of Negation and disruptive creatures like Tishana's Tidebinder helps control the game while still maintaining pressure. The deck also includes some land manipulation with Lórien Revealed and Boseiju, Who Endures to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost spells to quickly ramp up mana and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and cascade effects. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to keep up a fast pace and put pressure on the opponent early in the game. With a mix of creatures, spells, and lands specifically chosen for their synergy and efficiency, the deck is designed to consistently create explosive and aggressive plays to secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive spells and creatures. By casting cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the player can cascade into powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a fast-paced, aggressive gameplay. Additionally, the deck features a diverse mana base to support its multicolored spells and ensure consistent casting of its key cards.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out massive creatures with the Cascade mechanic, overwhelming opponents with powerful threats. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into spells like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to rapidly build a board presence and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline cards and Force of Negation helps to protect the strategy and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while the mana base is optimized for consistency and speed. The goal is to hit fast and hard, ending the game before the opponent can react effectively.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and deployed as needed to achieve a combo win condition. The creatures provide various forms of utility, such as sacrificing for value, creating tokens, or disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards that help tutor for the key creatures and lands needed to execute the combo efficiently. The combination of creature abilities, Chord of Calling, and Grist, the Hunger Tide allow for flexibility and adaptability in different matchups.

This deck focuses on using creatures with sacrifice abilities alongside Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value and control the board. The deck can tutor for specific creatures using Chord of Calling, creating a toolbox of options to fit the situation. Grist, the Hunger Tide is used as a win condition and to create a swarm of tokens. The deck also includes a small graveyard recursion package with cards like Endurance and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Overall, the deck aims to grind out value and outvalue the opponent with its synergistic creature combos.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also utilizing counterspells like Force of Negation and Spell Pierce to control the board. It combines aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower and Dauthi Voidwalker with removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut to pressure the opponent and maintain board presence. The deck also includes cards that can provide card advantage like Preordain and Not Dead After All, ensuring that the player has resources to outlast their opponent in a grindy matchup.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that can bring back multiple creatures from the graveyard and wipe the opponent's board. The deck uses cards like Subtlety, Grief, and Generous Ent to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain control until Living End can be cast. The deck also includes cards like Force of Negation and Violent Outburst to protect the combo and ensure it goes off smoothly. Overall, the key strategy is to quickly cycle through the deck, disrupt the opponent, and unleash a devastating Living End combo.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggression, using cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt your opponent's game plan while deploying efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also has a sacrifice sub-theme with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Undying Evil, allowing you to generate value from sacrificing your own creatures. Utilizing powerful removal like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy, forcing them to react to your threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive strategy utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to pressure the opponent early on. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Sheoldred's Edict to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide extra value and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive game plan by including lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Blood Crypt to ensure consistency and smooth mana curve.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key card, The One Ring, allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in casting spells. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent with card advantage and powerful threats like Solitude. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, allowing for the smooth casting of spells and ensuring the deck's overall game plan is executed efficiently.

It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to control the opponent's board. The deck includes powerful mill spells like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity, as well as card draw spells like Visions of Beyond to keep the mill going.
